IS 11304 : 2026 Control of Air Pollution in Iron and Steel Plants - Code of Practice
ICS 13.040.99
ICS 13.040.99
EED 02
EED 02
1 SCOPE
This standard provides guidance for controlling air pollution generated from various processes/sections of an iron and steel plant. It covers the following components:
a) Brief description of the process;
b) Generation of air pollutants; and
c) Measures to control air pollution.
